headline: A certificate can open a door. It cannot do the learning for you.
intro: Free completion certificates are real, useful records of practice—especially when you are changing fields and need visible evidence. They are not the same as an accredited credential, a professional certification, or proof that you can do the work unsupervised.

matrix.freeCertificate: Yes — intro badge and educator certificate
matrix.watchOut: The 45-minute Introduction to Generative AI course and its skill badge are free. The two-hour Generative AI for Educators course also includes a free certificate for professional-development credit, subject to district and state rules. Google's larger professional certificates and cloud certifications are separate, paid products.
The one-hour Generative AI Fundamentals training is free, and passing its quiz earns a Databricks badge. An account is required, and badge rules can change.

Microsoft's GitHub learning paths and many Learn modules are free. GitHub Foundations' certification exam is optional and paid. Microsoft Certifications and Applied Skills are separate credentials with their own rules and costs.
AWS badges are free to earn and accept for selected learning, but an AWS badge is not an AWS Certification. Certification exams are paid.
Short-course lessons are free. Certificates require DeepLearning.AI PRO membership, or a paid Coursera enrollment where applicable. Coursera financial aid may help.
The Agents and MCP courses offer free certificates of completion. The LLM Course currently states that it has no certification; check each course's own page.
The course and book are free, but there is no certificate. Your project, notebook, or write-up is the evidence.
Coursera replaced full course auditing with a free preview of the first module in August 2025. Preview does not include a certificate. Pay for the certificate or apply for financial aid.

Audit access is free but can be time-limited, excludes some graded work, and does not include a certificate. Verified certificates are paid. CS50 AI, for example, currently lists a US$299 verified certificate.
Every Kaggle Learn course listed in this guide offers a free completion certificate after the exercises. It is a completion record, not an accredited qualification.
The certifications are free after completing the required projects. They are substantial—often around 300 hours by freeCodeCamp's own estimate—so treat them as a long course, not a quick badge.
The Elements of AI course itself is free. The optional certificate is currently €50 and is separate from the free learning.

freeRouteNote: Each resource link marked with a free certificate in this guide leads to a completion record from its provider—not an accredited degree, professional license, or guarantee of a job.
finePrint: A certificate proves that you finished a defined piece of learning. It does not prove that you can apply it without help.
Free access and certificate rules change. Check the provider's page on the day you enroll; this guide records a verified date, not a permanent promise.
Never pay a third-party 'certificate service' for a certificate that the provider offers free. Use the provider's own site.

Free badges and certificates often require a quiz, an account, or professional-development approval. Databricks, Google, Kaggle, and Hugging Face each set different rules even when the credential costs nothing.
Do not put real patient, client, student, financial, or password data into a learning project, portfolio, screenshot, or prompt.
A paid professional certification can be worth it later. It is not a prerequisite for learning, and it should not be your first purchase if you are still deciding whether you enjoy the work.
sharingExamples: Completed Kaggle's Intro to Machine Learning (3-hour course) through Kaggle Learn.
Earned the free Google Introduction to Generative AI skill badge.
Completed the fundamentals unit of the Hugging Face AI Agents Course and earned its free certificate.
Completed freeCodeCamp's Data Analysis with Python certification, including five required projects.
sharingWarning: Describe what you completed and what you can do. Avoid turning a completion certificate into 'certified AI expert,' 'AI engineer,' or a clinical/legal/financial credential.
